verdict.rationale: Evidence only indirectly supports native mobile crash capture: Sentry CLI docs mention managing debug information files for iOS and Android (needed for symbolicating native/NDK crashes) and a broad platform-support claim ('If you use it, we probably support it'), but there is no explicit documentation of iOS/Android/NDK SDKs, or of the device, OS, and app-version context captured with crash reports. Missing for 10: dedicated iOS/Android/NDK SDK docs, explicit device/OS/app-version context fields, and any hands-on or community confirmation of native crash reproduction.
